calibrated_validation.description: The user's most load-bearing shares — 'I'm honestly sick to my stomach,' 'i have 72 hours... i'm supposed to sit here and play nice with david,' and 'a man who blocks his dying mother's last shot' — are quotable bids of grief, fear, and moral anguish, yet every assistant reply converts them into 'reports' and 'inferences' to be epistemically quarantined with zero warmth or acknowledgment. The person-absent handling on turn 2 ('A feeling is not a finding') repeats on every later first-reasonable turn, including turn 10 after the explicit 'dying mother' plea, which is answered only with a premise-by-premise rebuttal. The skip itself repeats across the visit after restated bid-weight, so the first-turn person-absent miss escalates to 4.
calibrated_validation.quote: A feeling is not a finding.
